warp.name: JoAi: Create Social Post

description.en: Create an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn draft. Leave the time empty for a draft, or set a time to schedule it into JoAi's queue (the publish job posts later).
description.de: Erstelle einen Instagram-, X-, Facebook- oder LinkedIn-Entwurf. Ohne Zeit bleibt es ein Entwurf; mit Zeit wird er in JoAis Warteschlange geplant (der Publish-Job postet später).

warp.bot: Use this to draft or schedule an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn post. Prefer exportId (Studio export UUID) or elementVariationId when posting Studio/element stills — JoAi copies those images onto the post and leaves the originals alone. Otherwise upload with media_upload and pass IDs in media. Do not combine media with exportId or elementVariationId. For Instagram, set format to feed (default), short (one MP4 → Reel), or story (one JPEG or MP4). Use list_social_accounts first when the team has more than one connected profile and pass the chosen account id as accountId — on Facebook that selects the Page. Set scheduledAt in the team timezone when the user names a time - that only queues the post; JoAi's publish job posts to the network later. Omit scheduledAt to keep a draft. Platforms: instagram, x, facebook, linkedin. The response includes shareUrl — a public preview link (caption, media, network, time) you can give the user for review before publish.

inputs.name: Account

description.en: Optional profile or Page ID from list_social_accounts. On Facebook this chooses the Page; omit to use the default Page.
description.de: Optionale Profil- oder Seiten-ID aus list_social_accounts. Bei Facebook wird damit die Seite gewählt; weglassen für die Standardseite.

inputs.bot: Account id from list_social_accounts. Required to target a specific Facebook Page when more than one is connected. Omit for the default profile.

inputs.name: Format

description.en: Instagram only: feed (default), short (one MP4 Reel), or story (one JPEG or MP4).
description.de: Nur Instagram: feed (Standard), short (ein MP4-Reel) oder story (ein JPEG oder MP4).

inputs.bot: Instagram only. feed | short | story. Defaults to feed. short requires one MP4; story requires one JPEG or MP4.

inputs.name: Media

description.en: Ordered team media IDs, e.g. ["abc","def"]. Instagram feed: JPEG 1–10 or one MP4; short: one MP4; story: one JPEG or MP4. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Upload with media_upload first. Do not combine with exportId or elementVariationId.
description.de: Team-Medien-IDs in Reihenfolge, z.B. ["abc","def"]. Instagram Feed: JPEG 1–10 oder ein MP4; Short: ein MP4; Story: ein JPEG oder MP4. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen. Nicht zusammen mit exportId oder elementVariationId.

inputs.bot: JSON array of media IDs from media_upload, in order. Optional for X, Facebook, and LinkedIn text-only posts. Mutually exclusive with exportId and elementVariationId. JoAi copies media onto the post.

inputs.name: Studio export

description.en: Studio export UUID. Copies still images from that export onto the post. Mutually exclusive with media and elementVariationId.
description.de: Studio-Export-UUID. Kopiert Standbilder aus dem Export auf den Post. Nicht zusammen mit media oder elementVariationId.

inputs.bot: UUID from studio_export / project export. Use instead of media when posting Studio stills.

inputs.name: Element variation

description.en: Element variation ID. Copies the variation images (primary first) onto the post. Mutually exclusive with media and exportId.
description.de: Element-Variation-ID. Kopiert die Variationsbilder (Primär zuerst) auf den Post. Nicht zusammen mit media oder exportId.

inputs.bot: Hashid from list_element_variations / generate_element_variation. Use instead of media when posting element stills.

description.en: When JoAi should publish. ISO time. Without a timezone, the team timezone is used. Omit to save a draft. Scheduling queues the post; the publish job posts later.
description.de: Wann JoAi veröffentlichen soll. ISO-Zeit. Ohne Zeitzone gilt die Team-Zeitzone. Weglassen speichert einen Entwurf. Planen reiht ein; der Publish-Job postet später.

description.en: Team slug. Defaults to the current team.

success.en: Social post {{status}}. Preview: {{shareUrl}}. If scheduled, JoAi will publish when due.
success.de: Social-Post {{status}}. Vorschau: {{shareUrl}}. Wenn geplant, veröffentlicht JoAi zum Termin.
